_note: Oldest-end sweep batch 75: 16-19 July 2026. Model claude-opus-5, prompt v1.

mentions.claim_text: He repeats that he saw an attack trying to come against the general assembly in New York, says they are going to pray over that for September, that there is a lot to pray about all the time, and then asks viewers to subscribe to the channel.
mentions.quote: So we're going to pray over that on the for September
mentions.falsify_match: Same event as the passage a minute earlier.
mentions.falsify_miss: Nothing new. Recorded because the passage is separately indexed, but it adds no detail to the 22-26 September window given moments before, and runs straight into a subscription pitch.

mentions.claim_text: He says the man will try to get the presidency in 2028 and will slither his belly up like the snake he is, that people will vote for him, that he saw the Illuminati and saw him cloak himself with a blue thing, that the Lord said they will use the 25th Amendment to try to take the president out along with impeachment through the Senate, that the 25th Amendment will be the major topic on the grounds that he is not mentally fit, to pray about the Supreme Court judges, and that the man is the ring leader and their poster boy along with Booker, while Kamala Harris rebrands herself.
mentions.quote: They will use the 25th Amendment to try to take him out with uh impeachment
mentions.falsify_match: A 25th Amendment push and an impeachment attempt, with the named man running in 2028.
mentions.falsify_miss: Neither move is made. Note that the 25th Amendment line was said on air by a critic in the clip he is reacting to, so it is a claim built on top of something already said publicly rather than ahead of it.

mentions.claim_text: He says to pray they do not win the Senate, that we still win and can still turn this thing by prayer as they did last time, but that he keeps seeing it bold that they will win the Senate, that we will keep the House by not as much and it will not be a landslide, that they will get both, and that the Senate is needed with seven more seats to pass the Save America Act.
mentions.quote: they'll win the Senate. We'll keep the House by not as much
mentions.falsify_match: Democrats take the Senate in November 2026.
mentions.falsify_miss: They do not. The passage says three incompatible things within a minute: we still win, they will win the Senate while we keep the House, and they will get both. Any result matches one of them.

mentions.claim_text: He says he is looking at the coast on the Atlantic side of Florida and that a major hurricane is coming, repeating it, and then moves to praying over the World Cup, people gathering in the streets and the subways.
mentions.falsify_match: A major hurricane striking Florida's Atlantic coast.
mentions.falsify_miss: None available. He gives no date and no season, only that it is coming, and major is undefined. Recorded without a window because attaching the 2026 Atlantic season would be my inference, not his statement.

mentions.claim_text: He says a revival is needed in Iran and Cuba, that President Trump has said he is going to research the drones, that the Lord revealed to them that there were drones given to them by Iran, that now they are talking about it in the news, and that they are praying over it.
mentions.quote: there was drones given to them by Iran. And now they're talking about it
mentions.falsify_match: Reporting that the drones came from Iran, postdating his statement.
mentions.falsify_miss: The reporting predates him, or the Iranian origin is not borne out. He scores it as a hit on the strength of the president saying he will look into it, which is not the same as the origin being established.

mentions.claim_text: He says they will be a major pillar in the end time church and revival will go out from there if they pray, that he saw Taiwan with a golden dome on all sides if the people will pray, that if they do not they will fall within three days, that he saw them fight for one and fight into two, and that by the end of the second day it will completely fold.
mentions.quote: I saw they'll fight for one. I saw they'll fight into two
mentions.condition_text: if the people of Taiwan pray
mentions.falsify_match: A Chinese takeover of Taiwan collapsing resistance inside two or three days.
mentions.falsify_miss: No invasion, but no date is given for one. The passage states both three days and folding by the end of the second, which does not agree with itself or with the two-day telling already on file.

mentions.claim_text: He says it is the same with Taiwan, that if the people of Taiwan do not pray he saw the whole nation fallen in three days, but that as they kept praying back in January and again in July the Lord said he will not allow them to be taken over until the tribulation, that in the tribulation he saw them falling to China, and that by praying they were buying more time.
mentions.quote: I'll not allow them to be taken over into until the tribulation
mentions.falsify_match: Taiwan holding until a period identified as the tribulation, then falling to China.
mentions.falsify_miss: None reachable. The deadline is moved to an event with no date, and prayer is credited with the delay, so an invasion at any time and no invasion at all both fit.

mentions.claim_text: He says people are tagging him on X saying JD Vance is already turning on Trump over the Epstein list, that he saw by midterms going into 2027 that Vance would break off and try to do his own thing, that he called him two-faced and saw him as a fish swimming in the White House with an Ivy League education, that he saw Marco Rubio rise up and believes God has put his hand on Rubio and not on Vance, and that Vance will become very outspoken in the days ahead.
mentions.quote: by midterms going into 2027 2020 he would he would break off
mentions.falsify_match: Vance publicly breaking with Trump between the midterms and the end of 2027.
mentions.falsify_miss: No break. He treats viewers tagging him about a news story as the claim already happening, which is a lower bar than the break he described.

mentions.claim_text: He says seeds sowed in the past will come to harvest at last, that he hears the sound of an abundance of rain, that the cleansing of the church is taking place right now and a greater manifestation will be seen on the news and social media going into October and into November, and that there is an acceleration from this month, July the seventh month, going into the first of the year, finishing the refiner's fire of the church.
mentions.quote: cleansing of the church going into the month of October
mentions.time_phrase: July going into the first of the year
mentions.falsify_match: Church scandals breaking in the news and on social media across the autumn.
mentions.falsify_miss: None. This is a fourth timing for the cleansing, and it names news coverage as the evidence, which is continuously available.

mentions.claim_text: He reports being shown that God is setting things straight in this church, that some things have been off and some wrong, that things which have been dysfunction show dysfunction and are not the way they are supposed to be, and that he is making it right.
mentions.quote: He's setting things straight in this church
mentions.falsify_match: unfalsifiable: no church is named, no wrong is specified and no time is given.

mentions.claim_text: He says he sees the tractors and the harvesters, that he sees the tractors on the month of October, and then declares in prayer that the Save America Act and the Clarity Act go into effect.
mentions.quote: I see the tractors on the month of October
mentions.falsify_match: The named acts taking effect in October, if the tractors stand for the legislation.
mentions.falsify_miss: Neither act moves in October. The image is not interpreted, so what would count as tractors in the month of October is left open.

mentions.claim_text: He says the Sooners passed Japan's own clarity act today, that it takes fuller effect in 2027, that the Lord said to watch the Sooners meaning Japan and South Korea and the Asian nations and that they would be first before America, that just as the Lord said it is happening, that he saw the boomer schooner wagon going across the land, and that South Korea has now recognised crypto as a national asset.
mentions.quote: the Japan and the Sooners will be first
mentions.falsify_match: Asian crypto legislation preceding the American equivalent, with Japan's in full effect in 2027.
mentions.falsify_miss: The American act lands first, or Japan's does not take effect in 2027. The original watch the Sooners statement should be in this corpus and can be dated against the Japanese vote, which is what would make this scoreable rather than asserted.
